proposal: Almost none of this CSS is dead: the one grep-suspect rule (.demo-mini--full) is built dynamically in mini.js:25, so nothing is safe to delete, and no DELETE is claimed. The proven waste is duplicates of the base button, field and .surface rules (demo-btn, dev-chat-back, dev-chat-input, .demo box) plus .ux-content-wall being a .grid.auto with --column:22em, and those can simply drop their declarations. The bigger win is building things once: one side-rail (DevBar and drawer), one chat thread + composer (Ask, Chat and the dev-bar chat are three), one menu, one popover/tooltip surface, one stat tile, one stepper, one level-meter and one list-row button. Dictate is already the single mic widget, so ask.css should just wear it instead of re-drawing the listening pulse. Timeline, DevBar tabs, files.css and the ui/* css blocks were only skimmed and are left KEEP-unverified; a second pass with a rule-by-rule diff against framework.css would find more.
risk: low for the DUPLICATE drops (base controls already paint them); medium for the GENERALIZE merges — chat, menu and popover each have several live callers
